sources.description: Despite the risks, a number of soldiers from the country seen as Russia’s biggest backer have found their way to Ukraine On the makeshift workbench in the cramped front room of a cottage near the frontlines of the Russia-Ukraine war, there are all the accoutrements of a drone workshop . The walls are lined with pliers and rolls of duct tape; the table is cluttered with screwdrivers and piles of wire. Propped up against the wall are two kamikaze drones. Only one item looks out of place in this Ukrainian village house: a pot of Chinese longjing tea, the leaves wilted from repeated top-ups. Good tea is one of the many things that Tim misses about his life in China. His parents post monthly supplies to Ukraine. “I think about all of it,” the 44-year-old said, of his home country. “It brings back memories and emotions.” Continue reading...

sources.title: 9月中国制造业采购经理指数为50.1% 升至扩张区间
sources.description: 中新网9月30日电 据中国物流与采购联合会网站消息，国家统计局服务业调查中心、中国物流与采购联合会发布的2026年9月份中国制造业采购经理指数(PMI)为50.1%，较上月上升0.3个百分点，在连续2个月运行在50%以下后回到扩张区间，显示9月份制造业运行有所回升。从分项指数和行业指数来看，市场需求整体稳定扩张，企业生产加快上升，市场价格联动上升，大型企业稳定增长，中小企业景气改善，整体来看制造业向好运行。
